title: Test Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from electronics, programming and engineering fundamentals into hardware/software testing, test automation, debugging, validation, quality processes and eventually system-level verification.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If an honours/research pathway is available, use the additional depth for verification, embedded testing, automation, reliability engineering or systems validation.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build programming, electronics, testing fundamentals, debugging, test documentation and automation skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Move into hardware validation, embedded testing, software QA, automation, system testing or reliability engineering.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior test, verification, validation or quality-engineering responsibilities.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine testing with AI-assisted automation, hardware-in-the-loop, cybersecurity testing, continuous testing and intelligent validation.

rows.text: C/C++, Python, electronics and digital logic
